Move.description: The verdict on moving a task to one column: allowed, or guarded by a declared rule.

allowed.description: False when a guard the board writer enforces would refuse the move.
allowed.title: Allowed

reason.description: What the refusing guard needs; empty when the move is allowed.
reason.title: Reason

skill.description: The skill that produces what the guard needs; empty when allowed.
skill.title: Skill

writers.description: The actors the machine YAML declares for the event behind the move; empty when it declares none, and then any actor may make it.
writers.title: Writers

Move.title: Move

description: One task on the board, as the latest observation of it.

id.description: The task key, matching the adapter's declared `TaskKeys.key` (`PROJ-45`, `ENG-123`).
id.title: Id

lane.description: The id of the Board machine state the task is in (`in_progress`): its status, lower-cased, spaces as `_`.
lane.title: Lane

dependencies.description: Keys of the tasks this one waits on.
dependencies.title: Dependencies

references.description: Links and paths the task cites; the pull request URLs among them are drawn as its PRs.
references.title: References

settled.description: Set when the task has left the lanes for good, `completed` or `archived`; `lane` is then ignored.
settled.title: Settled

assignee.description: Who or which agent model holds the task; empty when unassigned.
assignee.title: Assignee

milestone.description: The milestone the task belongs to; empty when it has none.
milestone.title: Milestone

description.description: The task's description text, shown when the task is opened.
description.title: Description

moves.description: The verdict on each Board column the task may move to, by state id; empty for a settled task.
moves.title: Moves

title: BoardTask
